Jet pT-Response Regression — Tier 0+1 Report

Branch dfm-merge, 2026-08-08. Study plan: dfm/JET_ENERGY_STUDY.md (decisions D1–D5 resolved with Amir).

1. What was done, exactly

  1. Dataset: 4 of 17 5D ttbar files (11+12 train / 13 val / 14 test) → one sample per truth-matched light jet: cuts HadronConeExcl==0, pt_true > 20 GeV, recomputed dR(reco,truth) < 0.3, |eta| < 2.5, duplicate-truth guard. Isolation (reco: no jet pt>15 in dR<0.8; truth: no other match in dR<1.0) is a stored flag (D1). Cutflow: 1.05M jets → 146k kept (~36.5k/file).
  2. Per jet: target y = ln(pt_true/pt_reco) (D2); 6 jet features; ghost-associated tracks ×18 features (IP significances from covariances); cone (dR<0.4) cells ×7 features from Cell_significance; the cells' calo neighbor subgraph, obtained by exact (x,y,z)+sampling cell matching → hash position → compact index → restricted pair list (0 unmatched cells in 146k jets).
  3. Training: isolated jets only (~40k), flat-in-log-pT weights (20–250 GeV, capped), Huber warmup → heteroscedastic Gaussian NLL → per-jet (μ, σ); AdamW + cosine, early stop on val NLL; 3 seeds × 4 configs on 4×A30 (5–8 min/run). Normalization and weights from train files only.
  4. Tier-0 gate: test response median 1.065 ∈ [0.90, 1.15] → PASSED.

2. Dataset diagnostics

3. How the metrics are computed

Per bin of pTtrue (and |η|, φ): the corrected response of each jet is r_corr = (pt_reco/pt_true) · exp(μ), i.e. the model's correction applied multiplicatively. Then

  • JES / closure = median(r_corr) per bin — target within ±1–2% of 1;
  • JER = (q75 − q25)/1.349 ÷ median — the Gaussian-equivalent robust width (never a Gaussian fit on tails);
  • pull = (y − μ)/σ — unit-normal if the per-jet σ is honest;
  • NLL/MAE on y as scalar model-comparison summaries.

5. Findings and next steps

F1 — graph beats set (C2 answered). Same tokens, same budget: the calo neighbor graph is worth ΔNLL≈0.11 and better closure everywhere. Detector topology is a real inductive bias even for ~30-cell cones (median degree 2.8).
F2 — constituents carry resolution; the jet 4-vector doesn't. J improves JER by exactly zero (0.226 vs 0.227) - it can only re-center. T and C both cut JER ~30%. Cells win at high pT, consistent with calorimetry.
F3 — the isolation gap is real (JER@65: 0.171 vs 0.158 for T) - the Stage-2 event-level claim now has a measured target.
P1 — closure protocol: the 1–2% bulk target is missed via (a) the universal 20–30 GeV non-closure (spectrum-edge migration) and (b) a ~2% low offset of NLL-trained models (mean-of-log vs median-of-ratio). Both were predicted in the plan review; fixes queued for Tier 2: an MAE-trained variant and/or numerical inversion in the evaluator.

Proposed Tier 2: TC-graph, JC-graph, TJ, TC-set, C-graph+μ, + TC-graph-mae (≈18 runs, ~1.5 h). Awaiting go-ahead per D3.
